findings.title: player1_id in canonical_player_events/1 is a polymorphic actor id; only one of its four non-player classes is handled anywhere
findings.already_declared: EVENT_LIMITATIONS.md gap 1 declares the team-id-in-person-field behaviour FOR REBOUNDS ONLY (23,131 rows)
findings.extension_measured_here: 15,595 further rows across timeout (12,227), turnover (2,803), violation (520) and foul (45); plus 629 official-shaped ids over 3,117 rows and 39 non-roster person ids over 187 rows, neither class declared anywhere

findings.title: cold start is two orthogonal axes wearing one word: player history and fold degeneracy
findings.statement: fallback_level == 4 is an exact indicator function of the 2021 fold (4,989 of 4,989 obligations, both targets, zero rows elsewhere), and 13,944 regime-expanded level-4 rows carry is_cold_start = False with a median of 12 prior appearances

findings.title: the implemented is_cold_start is player-season; the spec defines it player-team-season
findings.consequence: 75 obligations that are a player's debut for a new club, after she has already played elsewhere that season, all carry is_cold_start = False

findings.title: is_cold_start is a statement about admitted evidence, not about the player
findings.statement: n_prior_appearances counts ADMITTED prior appearances; 474 of 28,107 audited obligations (1.69%) carry a value exactly one below reality, in that direction on every row. False-cold-start rate: 2 obligations.

findings.title: the conditional-minutes fallback ladder rule is undeclared in every readable artifact
findings.statement: level 3 implies n_prior_appearances <= 1, but of 1,898 ex-2021 obligations with exactly one prior appearance, 1,697 sit at level 2 and 201 at level 3. The discriminating field is not emitted and cbs_v15 is outside this node's read scope.

findings.title: the structural full-team cold start is handled correctly and is the pattern the rest of the fallback surface should follow

tier_A_only.note: one per club per season; league size 12/12/12/12/13/15

findings.statement: every club's season opener carries zero Tier A candidates (76 team-games, exactly league size each season) and is declared unresolved rather than given a manufactured rotation. The weak tiers rescue 74; the two that remain are both 2021 openers, the hard floor of this program's cold start.

findings.title: multi-club candidacy must be reported per tier or it misdescribes transfers by a factor of five
findings.statement: Tier A: 91 of 1,058 player-seasons (8.6%), max 3 clubs, against a realised 82 of 1,039 (7.9%). Tier B: 678 of 1,496 (45.3%), max 7 clubs. The Tier B figure is candidate inflation, not movement.

escalations.statement: V2_STOP_CONDITION.json finding S6 records that the incumbent's largest measurable defect is a level error ON THE COLD-START STRATA (bias 37.1% of MSE on team_window_prior_season, 42.5% on season_openers, against 0.19% pooled) and that whether K0_MATCHED carries the tier structure decides the wave. Any construction stratifying by a cold-start indicator inherits the X1 grain question: under the spec's team-scoped definition 75 obligations move stratum; under the implemented player-scoped one they do not. The definition must be settled BEFORE any stratum is frozen into a control. This does not change which rows are in the universe, only which stratum counts them.

V2_STOP_CONDITION.json finding S7 raises per-fold degeneracy for the TEAM PACE ladder — a tier indicator identically zero in four of six chronological folds, landing on the authoritative control. The same shape is present on the PLAYER ladder and S7 does not name it. fallback_level == 4 is not merely degenerate in some folds; it is an EXACT indicator function of the 2021 fold, 4,989 of 4,989, for both targets. A design matrix carrying both a fold effect and a player fallback-level dummy is rank-deficient by construction, not by accident of sparsity.
escalations.what_this_node_did_not_do: no rank or estimability check was run on any design matrix; feature_gate.py, comparison_gate.py and gate_invocation.py were not touched

escalations.statement: every granular event channel the wave might build — turnovers by mechanism, rebounds, fouls — reads player1_id. A naive join attributes 7.32% of actor-bearing rows to non-existent players, and the largest affected family is rebound (23,131 rows), which EVENT_LIMITATIONS.md already flags as carrying rebound_type = unresolved on all 125,309 rows. NO EXISTING ARTIFACT WAS SHOWN TO BE CORRUPTED: player_turnover_targets/1 handles the team class exactly (2,803 = 2,803) and player_possessions/2 derives from stints rather than a player1_id join. This is a prospective hazard on the feature set, not a retrospective defect, escalated so it is closed before an event-channel arm is written rather than after.
